description: Source code for the CombinationChartRenderer class, which handles rendering of combined chart types in PDFsharp charting library.

classes.name: CombinationChartRenderer
classes.description: Renderer class for combined chart types, managing layout, drawing, and series distribution.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific info, including series and axes setup.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout and space allocation for the combined chart.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the combined chart, including series, axes, legend, and labels.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Initializes series renderer info objects for each series in the chart.

methods.name: DistributeSeries
methods.description: Sorts and groups series renderer info based on chart type (Area, Column, Line).
